feedback: OAuth setup was straightforward, but I would like a clearer callback URL checklist for local and production environments.
Please make it easier to understand why an OAuth callback is rejected when moving from localhost to a deployed app.
Debugging failed social login redirects takes too long because the console message does not explain which redirect URI mismatched.
Email and password authentication worked quickly and the SDK flow was easy to follow.
I need a single screen that shows active sessions and lets me revoke one device without logging out every device.
The database API is pleasant to use, and typed columns helped us catch mistakes early.
Large data imports need better progress visibility because we cannot tell whether a job is slow or stuck.
I would like import progress, processed row counts, and a downloadable list of rejected rows.
The query builder should explain which index is missing instead of returning only a generic performance warning.
Relationships reduced application code, but an example for migrating existing linked records would help.
Multipart uploads should resume automatically after a brief network interruption.
Our users upload large media files and restarting from zero after a connection drop is frustrating.
Image preview transformations are useful and saved us from operating a separate image service.
Please show storage usage by bucket so we can identify which product feature is consuming quota.
Cold starts make webhook processing unpredictable, and I need a latency breakdown in the execution view.
Function logs need better filtering by execution status and deployment version.
It is difficult to compare two function deployments when environment variables change.
Deploying a small function from source control was much easier than maintaining a separate service.
Realtime reconnects after my laptop wakes up, but the UI briefly shows stale records.
After a network interruption, subscriptions reconnect but some updates appear to be missing until a full refresh.
We need an obvious connection-state event so the app can warn users when realtime data may be stale.
Please document a recommended resync pattern after a realtime client reconnects.
Intermittent connections can leave our dashboard out of date, and we need a reliable catch-up mechanism.
A resume token or last-seen event cursor would make reconnect behavior safer.
The SDK should expose whether a reconnect performed a full resubscribe and whether events could have been missed.
The messaging API reduced the time needed to add notifications to our prototype.
A delivery timeline showing queued, sent, delivered, and failed states would help support teams.
Please provide clearer failure reasons when a notification provider rejects a message.
Deploying the frontend from GitHub was simple and the generated preview URL was useful.
We need a clearer indication of which commit is live after a deployment rollback.
Build logs should keep the error summary visible instead of requiring us to scan the entire output.
Examples across JavaScript and Python use different terminology, which makes switching SDKs confusing.
The generated types make the TypeScript SDK comfortable to use.
Migration notes should include before-and-after code for every breaking SDK change.
The console needs a global search for projects, functions, buckets, and database tables.
The recent console navigation changes made common project settings easier to find.
Audit history should show which teammate changed a permission and the previous value.
The self-hosting guide needs a production checklist covering backups, upgrades, TLS, and monitoring.
Upgrade documentation should call out required database migrations before containers restart.
Necesitamos una guía más clara para hacer copias de seguridad antes de actualizar una instalación.
Sería útil ver el progreso de una importación grande y descargar las filas rechazadas.
Después de reconectar, la aplicación debería indicar si necesita sincronizar los datos otra vez.
